comments.note: src/plugins/ledger/index.ts — warnOnUnknownRole option is declared in LedgerPluginOptions (line 66) but never destructured in the ledgerPlugin() factory (line 83 only destructures manifestRoles). The onValidate hook calls validateRole(role, manifestRoles) unconditionally and always gets a 'warning'-severity result. AC-4 requires: warnOnUnknownRole:false → severity:'error'; warnOnUnknownRole:true → severity:'warning'. Neither path exists. Fix: destructure warnOnUnknownRole = true from options, pass it to validateRole() or map the returned severity before returning from onValidate.

The project has no established numeric threshold to compare against. The Developer or a PM decision is needed: either (a) install @vitest/coverage-v8 and add a coverage threshold to vitest.config.ts, or (b) relax AC-6 to 'functional coverage confirmed by test count' and update the criterion text accordingly.

Code verified against all 4 Review Dimensions: Maintainability, Best Practices, Performance, and Future Context — all pass.

Architecture: the deliberate separation of concerns between validateRole() (always returns 'warning') and ledgerPlugin() (escalates to 'error' when warnOnUnknownRole=false) is correct and well-motivated. The validator is a pure data function; the plugin controls policy. This is a strong design choice.
The onValidate severity escalation (lines 159–166 of index.ts) uses an inline .map() transform that is clear and type-safe. The 'as const' assertion on the escalated severity is correct TypeScript.

The renderedOutputCache fallback ('?? ""') on line 171 is a correct defensive guard for validate-only invocations where onPostRender was never called. The uncovered branch is acceptable (97.29% branch coverage already exceeds 80% threshold).
Test file: 48 tests are comprehensive, well-structured, and cover all ACs. Fixtures are reused correctly. Import style is idiomatic vitest.
vitest.config.ts: Coverage configuration is correct — v8 provider, 80% on all four axes, src/cli.ts excluded with explanatory comment. No issues.

[documentation-forward] src/plugins/ledger/index.ts LedgerPluginOptions.warnOnUnknownRole JSDoc (lines 62–66): The option-level doc says it 'emits a warning-level ValidationResult instead of being silently skipped' but this description is now slightly misleading — the option controls whether an unknown role escalates from warning to error, not whether it is 'silently skipped'. The JSDoc should be updated to read: 'When true (default), an unknown role field emits a warning-level ValidationResult. When false, the same condition escalates to error-level, treating unknown roles as hard build failures.' This will help future contributors understand the escalation contract without needing to read the factory implementation.
